title: Future Engine
overview: Senku and Dr. Xeno team up to gather the materials needed to make a rocket engine.

title: Fire
overview: The crew arrives in Spain, where they collect fluorite, olive oil and some treats.

title: The Universe Is Written in the Language of Mathematics
overview: The New Perseus sets out to India to recruit mathematicians for the space program.

title: Dawn of the Computer
overview: The computer that the team is building is a series of toroidal tubes. Senku explains.

title: The Truth About the Rocket
overview: The team gets to work wiring up several megabits' worth of memory donuts for their computer.

title: Stone to Space
overview: The team will need a stupidly insane amount of electricity to turn their bauxite into an aluminum rocket body.

title: Unknown Known
overview: With the computer completed, the team will need a user interface: a TV.

title: Challengers of Science
overview: The Kingdom of Science's rocket launches are mired by a string of rapid unscheduled disassemblies.

title: Wanting Everything
overview: The team is too small to build a round-trip rocket. They'll need to enlist help from around the world.

title: Countdown
overview: Ryusui may need to defer to a better pilot for the moon mission.

title: Giant Step
overview: The rocket needs to be assembled in space. Not an easy feat in the 21st century, let alone in the stone world.

title: Why-Man
overview: The team sets foot on the moon to confront Why-Man.

title: Ushers of an Exhilarating Future
overview: Senku offers Why-Man more exhilaration than they can handle.
